title: Aileron response to controller input (step/pulse)
objective: To demonstrate that the simulation of roll characteristics after a roll control input has been removed conforms to the validation data.
tolerance_catalog: ± 10% or ± 2º/s roll rate (p) | ± 2º bank angle (phi) | ± 1.5 cm or ± 10% wheel displacement
runtime_configuration: Existing main.py test settings and common engine remain authoritative
